messages:
alex: FYI I ran a perf sweep. Observed a regression on long sequences (>2k). Triton path is chosen initially but we see fallback to CUTLASS/CUDA mid-stream which kills latency. Profiling below.

maria: Can you paste the perf log and the autotune decisions? Is this on cc8.6 nodes?

alex: cc8.6, batch=4. Here's the debug dump:
```
[autotune] input_seq=4096 batch=4 -> tried triton_matmul_fast (est 90ms) -> runtime 180ms -> fallback to cutlass_gemm32 (exec 95ms)
[kv] memcpy stage: 72ms
[total] tokens=4096 -> 420ms
```

kevin: So Triton performed worse on that run; maybe internal tiling picks are bad for very tall GEMMs. Did autotuner prefer Triton based on small seq samples?

sophie: Right — our autotune currently uses sample seq_len=128,512 which biases for short paths. We need sequence-length-aware profiling.

maria: Also noticed KV cache layout causes an extra memcpy when switching kernel backends: Triton expects contiguous KV on GPU, CUTLASS uses differently-sharded buffers, so we copy. That's likely the 72ms.

bench-bot: perf-run 1751289200: batch=4 seq=4096 cc=8.6 latency=421ms (baseline 310ms). logs: https://internal.redwood/runs/17512892

alex: Proposed quick fix: add policy that forces CUTLASS for seq>=2048 on cc8.6 until autotune is updated. Could add metric to autotuner to include memcpy cost.

kevin: We should also add a cheap sequence-length histogram to routing so we don't do full autotune for every model. Use recent 1k requests to choose path.

sophie: Agreed. Patch idea:
```
routing:
  seq_hist_window: 1000
  seq_thresholds: [512, 2048]
  prefer: {
    "<=512": "triton_fast",
    ">512": "cutlass_tall"
  }
autotune:
  allow_kernel_memcopy_cost: true
```

maria: Can someone run a verification sweep (batch 1/4/8, seq 256/1024/4096) with KV pinned vs unpinned? I'll instrument memcpy timings.

alex: I'll run cc8.6/cc8.0 matrix and post results. If we confirm, we'll make a canary deploy with routing policy and a fallback cooldown to avoid flapping.

infra-bot: deploy-canary started for routing-policy-seqlen-2026-03-17 by alex at 1751289300 :rocket:

kevin: Also add a regression test in perf-ci: synthetic request with seq=4096 and assert p50 < 450ms.

alex: Thanks team. I'll post raw traces once runs complete. :thumbsup:
